newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady to up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady to up.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices remained mostly steady to higher on Tuesday as dealers watched the continued run-up in Chicago Board of Trade corn prices.
"With the board up on corn, people are keeping their offers high and I don't know if there is any trading going on," a Kansas City dealer said.

"It's hot here but it is expected this time of the year," the dealer said. But the heat has not affected pastures so far, he added. "Demand is probably better than two or three weeks ago but it is still pretty sluggish."
He noted that supplies were plentiful but not burdensome as they were a few weeks ago.
Nothing changed much from Monday, a North Carolina dealer said, referring to the animals off of feed due to high temperatures in the southeast.
